notes.title: Version 1.11 update.
notes.content:
Version 1.11 is now available.

This version includes bug fixes, and attack animations that makes it more clear who attack whom in the game.

tags.feature: and attack animations that makes it more clear who attack whom in the game.

notes.title: Version 1.075.
notes.content:
Version 1.075 is released.

Important bug fix:
* Fixed dialogs bugs in 4k resolution(UHD).

And a few other small bug fixes.

tags.bug: And a few other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.06 Windows update.
notes.content:
Version 1.06 changes the following:
1) Fix AI issues when enemies would stop to chase you beyond opened gate.
2) Enemy now goes back to wander if it cannot reach the player.
3) Fixed bug when you stand on a door tile you cannot hit or get hit by enemies.
4) Cleave now hits 4 enemies in an L shape. 

Hopefully no new bugs are introduced.

tags.bug: 1) Fix AI issues when enemies would stop to chase you beyond opened gate.
3) Fixed bug when you stand on a door tile you cannot hit or get hit by enemies.
